processor: SIAC v1, MarcYin/SIAC commit fc6e592 as run in our pipeline (compatibility changes only: data access, Python 3.12 / numpy fixes, AOI windowing, CAMS time-index fallback; solver unchanged); Sentinel-2 entry point, run per scene with an AOI around each site
reference: RadCalNet published surface reflectance (.input files), five of the six sites (BTCN excluded: the window is larger than its target)
siac_value: median of SIAC v1 BOA over a 21 x 21 native-pixel window centred on the site (0.21 km for 10 m bands, 0.42 km for 20 m bands, 1.26 km for 60 m bands)
siac_uncertainty: SIAC v1's own per-pixel BOA uncertainty (*_unc), median over the same window
radcalnet_uncertainty: RadCalNet reported surface uncertainty, band-integrated, treated as k=1
residual: SIAC v1 BOA minus RadCalNet surface reflectance
frac_within_1sigma_centre_removed: same, after subtracting that site x band's mean residual; in-sample diagnostic of dispersion only, not a corrected product
excluded: Baotou samples whose window is larger than the RadCalNet target (all BTCN samples and the 20 m / 60 m bands at BSCN), scenes where only a whole-granule mean was available, and the atmospheric bands B9/B10
band_integration: RadCalNet 10 nm spectrum weighted by ESA's published spectral response of the Sentinel-2 MSI band for the relevant unit (S2A, S2B or S2C; Sentinel-2 Spectral Response Functions, COPE-GSEG-EOPG-TN-15-0007 v4.0) (SRF-only weighting, no solar-irradiance weighting); RadCalNet's per-wavelength uncertainty is carried as fully correlated across wavelengths within a band (upper bound) and treated as k=1, because RadCalNet publishes no coverage factor
